rationale: This low-float gapper has fully round-tripped its spike (36.6% off the high) yet is holding slightly above both prior close and session VWAP on a nearly frozen tape (last five 5-min bars averaged under 600 shares), giving mixed directional signals rather than a clean continuation or reversal. The 275 bps spread is roughly 3.5x the 5-min ATR of $0.08, so round-trip execution cost exceeds any realistic move in the 31 minutes remaining, and a short carries unverified borrow plus squeeze risk with 45% of the float already turned over. Neither side offers an edge that survives the liquidity and cost structure, so the correct mechanical play is no trade.
